mentions.name: autotude
mentions.description: A reinforcement learning project that builds bots for the multiplayer game Planeball. The game's Java client/server (from 2010) was patched to be controllable through protobuf messages, enabling recording of games between humans, a replay viewer that displays the whole map, defining bots in Python/PyTorch and running them in fast offline training mode, and running Python-defined bots online against human players. The goal is to produce an easy-to-use reinforcement learning environment that other people can play with.
mentions.problem: The game (a Java app written in 2010) had to be adapted to work as a reinforcement learning environment, and it previously had no recording feature.
mentions.audience: Other people who want to play with the reinforcement learning environment; the replay viewer is aimed at existing players of the game.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on using reinforcement learning to build some better bots for my favorite multiplayer game. Project is up here: https://github.com/cgadski/autotude
